integrity.proof_basis: Analytic finite-rank approximation, compact spectral perturbation, positive compact-map eigenvector principle, and word grouping

scientific_limitations: Conjugate nonzero spectral multisets are asserted for compact entries or for the specified m-th powers under compact-word conditions, not arbitrary noncompact tuples.
Positive compact eigenoperators require a nonzero spectral radius; finite-section convergence requires compact entries and a strongly exhaustive sequence of finite-rank projections.
The scope is row and column tuple radii, not arbitrary operator-space structures; equivalent older elementary-operator theorems remain a publication-priority risk.
title: Compact-word spectral duality for row and column tuple radii
